whyUs.f4_desc: All your personal data is encrypted and hosted in France. The platform is SSL secured, and the electronic signature is eIDAS certified — the European standard for legal signing.

security.g4_desc: You receive a personal encrypted link by email. This link expires after use — impossible to reuse or intercept.
security.g5_desc: The collection is required by Article R321-3 of the French Internal Security Code for all professionals in second-hand goods buyback.
security.g6_desc: Access, rectification, early deletion: exercise your rights at any time by contacting us at contact@power-exhaust.com.
